label: risky
summary: A pull request test workflow grants GITHUB_TOKEN write access to every permission scope.

findings.title: Workflow grants write-all token permissions
findings.description: The workflow grants GITHUB_TOKEN write access to every permission scope even though the job only runs tests. If a workflow step or action is compromised, the token can modify repository resources.
findings.recommendation: Declare only the permissions required by the workflow, such as contents: read, and grant additional scopes only to jobs that need them.

evidence.observation: The workflow sets permissions to write-all.

uncertainty: Repository or organization policy may further restrict the effective token permissions.
For pull requests from forks, GitHub issues a read-only GITHUB_TOKEN regardless of the requested permissions; the write scope applies to same-repository branches.
